ACADEMIC & IMMIGRATION READINESS

Why English Language Proficiency Matters

English proficiency is an essential part of international university admission and, depending on the destination and study route, may also be required for visa issuance.

ALO Education guides students through university prerequisites, course-specific benchmarks, destination visa compliance, and test selection to ensure you invest your preparation time strategically.

* Note: Requirements vary by country, immigration route, university, and specific course level. Always check official prerequisites.

IELTS Academic

IDP IELTS, British Council & Cambridge University Press & Assessment

IELTS (International English Language Testing System) is the world's premier standardized test of English language proficiency for non-native English language speakers seeking higher education or professional registration abroad.

Exam Fee in BD:BDT 23,000 - 24,500
Result Timeline:3 to 5 Days (Computer) / 13 Days (Paper)
Target Score:Band 6.5 - 7.5 Overall (Min 6.0 each module)
🇬🇧 UKVI Approved SELT2 Hours 45 Minutes

IELTS for UKVI (SELT)

UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI) & IELTS Consortium

IELTS for UKVI is a government-approved Secure English Language Test (SELT) that complies with strict administrative security protocols specified by UK Visas and Immigration.

Exam Fee in BD:BDT 24,500 - 25,500
Result Timeline:3 to 5 Days (Computer) / 13 Days (Paper)
Target Score:Band 5.5 - 6.5 Overall for UK Visa Routes
🇦🇺 🇬🇧 🇳🇿 🇨🇦 Pearson Official2 Hours

PTE Academic

Pearson Education Ltd

PTE Academic is a computer-based English language test trusted by universities, colleges and governments around the world.

Exam Fee in BD:BDT 22,000 - 23,000
Result Timeline:Typically 48 Hours (often within 24 hours)
Target Score:Score 58 - 68+ Overall (Min 50-58 communicative skills)
🇺🇸 🇨🇦 🇬🇧 ETS Official1 Hour 56 Minutes

TOEFL iBT

Educational Testing Service (ETS)

TOEFL iBT (Test of English as a Foreign Language internet-based test) evaluates non-native speakers on their academic reading, listening, speaking, and writing abilities.

Exam Fee in BD:BDT 22,500 - 24,000
Result Timeline:4 to 8 Days
Target Score:Score 80 - 100+ Overall (Min 20-22 per section)
🇺🇸 🇨🇦 🇬🇧 Online Adaptive1 Hour

Duolingo English Test (DET)

Duolingo Inc.

The Duolingo English Test is a modern language proficiency tool designed for international students and institutions, available online on demand.

Exam Fee in BD:BDT 7,200 ($59 USD)
Result Timeline:48 Hours
Target Score:Score 110 - 130+ Overall (Subscores: Literacy, Comprehension, Conversation, Production)
🇬🇧 Oxford ELLT OfficialModular: 4 Separate Stages

Oxford ELLT (OIETC)

Oxford International Education Group (OIEG)

The Oxford ELLT (English Language Level Test) is a modular online and test centre English language proficiency assessment created by Oxford International.

Exam Fee in BD:£120 GBP (BDT 18,500)
Result Timeline:Typically 48 Hours
Target Score:Level 6 - 8 (B2 to C1 Equivalent)
🏥 Professional Healthcare3 Hours approx.

OET (Healthcare)

Cambridge Boxhill Language Assessment (CBLA)

The Occupational English Test (OET) is an international English language test that assesses the language communication skills of healthcare professionals.

Exam Fee in BD:AUD $587 (approx BDT 46,000)
Result Timeline:16 Days
Target Score:Grade B (350+ out of 500) per sub-test
🇪🇺 PeopleCert Official2.5 Hours

LanguageCert International ESOL

LanguageCert (PeopleCert Group)

LanguageCert International ESOL is a suite of English language qualifications mapped to the CEFR, designed for university admission and visas.

Exam Fee in BD:£180 (approx BDT 27,000)
Result Timeline:3 Days
Target Score:High Pass (33+/50 per module) at B2 or C1

Common questions about English language tests for international students
